notes.title: Super Drift Blade Playtest Update #1
notes.notes:
Hi every one:

Thanks for the feedback, this update is as follows:

What's New:
[olist]
 Added many new puzzles.
 Many new clues have been added.
 Your mouse is now invaded, so please don't mess with your mouse!
[/olist]
Patch:
[olist]
 Updated localization for Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, and Japanese. (Main menu, pause screen, Steam page)
 Fixed sound adjustment adjustment issue.
 Fixed music adjustment issue.
 Added white transparent image behind the pause button, it's more visible.
 Added the effect of being injured by a hit, bleeding and darkening the screen.
 Fixed the issue of repeating background music.
 Fixed the problem that blood and qi will not be full after attribute increase.
 Fixed mouse click anti-dulling mechanism.
 Fixed mouse click anti-dumbing mechanism.


Liujiajun
December 6, 2024
